The '''Lizardman Settlement''' is an area in the [[Kebos Lowlands]] inhabited by [[Lizardmen]], between [[Mount Quidamortem]] and [[Shayziens' Wall]]. In the north is [[Xeric's Shrine]].

Players going to the [[Chambers of Xeric]] for the first time will need to pass through this area. It is recommended to bring [[antipoison]] while moving through this area since the lizardmen can [[poison]] you.

[[Dwarf multicannon]]s can't be placed in the area or inside [[Lizardman Caves]] where [[lizardman shaman]]s can be fought during slayer tasks. A message will appear with the text "There's something in the swampy atmosphere around here that inteferes with your cannon."

==Transportation==
The Lizardman Settlement can be reached by various methods:

* Using the [[fairy ring]] (code {{Fairycode|BLS}}) and running north-east towards the bridge and continue into the swamp
* The [[skills necklace]] or [[Farming cape]] provide teleports to the [[Farming Guild]] then running south through the [[River Molch]] towards [[Xeric's Shrine]], then continue south
